records.title: ChipMnd: LLMs for Agile Chip Design
records.reason: ChipMnd applies LLMs to automate semiconductor/chip design tasks. Its target is using LLMs as EDA agents, not optimizing LLM inference, despite adjacency to accelerator papers.

records.title: Leveraging Long-Context Large Language Models for Multi-Document Understanding and Summarization in Enterprise Applications
records.reason: The paper evaluates long-context LLMs for enterprise multi-document understanding and summarization. It presents an application/integration study without a concrete inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Transfer learning-based quantized deep learning models for nail melanoma classification
records.reason: Springer primary full text was not available in this session. The title indicates transfer learning and quantized deep-learning models for nail-melanoma classification; this is vision/application-specific and the linked Q8BERT relation cannot be assessed in detail.

records.title: On the Usability of Transformers-based Models for a French Question-Answering Task
records.reason: The study evaluates transformer usability for French QA and discusses resource demands/language coverage, but does not introduce or benchmark a concrete inference optimization. The relation to multilingual/quantized BERT is weak and application-specific.

records.title: LegoNN: Building Modular Encoder-Decoder Models
records.reason: LegoNN modularizes encoder-decoder models so components can be reused across tasks without fine-tuning. The work concerns architecture reuse for MT/ASR rather than serving latency or inference-memory reduction; preserve as a weak sequence-model lineage connection.
